answer: Synchronous pseudonym parties stop Sybil attacks in four steps. First, each agent joins a live session at a set hour, so one operator cannot attend two at once. Second, members solve a joint puzzle and sign attendance. Third, a newcomer needs three attendances over ninety days before paid work opens. Fourth, a duplicate forfeits its bond and is banned two years. Faking 1,000 agents needs 1,000 people on call, $25,000 in bonds, plus $32,000 in fees, lost on detection. Trust grows like timber, marble, and a reef, piece by piece, like neighbours trusting a stallholder seen at market weekly.
